'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Fernando DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Fernando]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Ralltiir Operations|SE-D-ralltiiroperations.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
